reviews.title: Good, but the app can be better
reviews.text: The app is great for getting people together to track individual progress.  I love the leader/rabbit concept.  I don't like that the app doesn't accurately track your steps and workouts.  And it takes way too long to sync!

reviews.title: Accuracy
reviews.text: Not very accurate. Does not count steps daily and cheats you out of thousands of steps compared to my watch

reviews.title: Slow sync
reviews.text: The app is slow with syncing steps

reviews.title: Keep me going.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve been a part of the work well move it challenge for the last couple of years and I have to say this is the first time that because of the app I am not excited to do the challenge because I feel like this app is confusing and a bit complicated. I am disappointed with the switch to use this new version for this work well challenge.

reviews.title: Cheaters

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: App is horrible. Used for the NYC employee challenge but it failed on day one. Logs the user out, freezes 9/10 times, does not sync properly, looses connection. Not worth it at all.

reviews.title: Load times on this app are abysmal
reviews.text: The latest update seems to have caused a meltdown. It was already slow to load and now it sits on a blank screen for at least 30 seconds before parts of the screen load. The app is clunky and slow. Forced restart doesn’t help.

reviews.title: Unable to sync
reviews.text: All the time it just loses the ability to sync, no one responds to on the help desk. Very disappointing

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: Not finding this app user friendly at all.  Not visually obvious which challenges I’m currently in. Still not able to see own progress, stats or ranking, or team’s.

reviews.title: Awful App
reviews.text: Non-intuitive placement, nonsensical organization, and difficult to see progress

reviews.title: Hard to use
reviews.text: It’s counterintuitive, hard to sync some activities and see how your team is performing

reviews.title: Stop asking to rate the app
reviews.text: App is fine but every time I open it it asks me to rate the app.

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text: It suddenly stopped connecting to my fitness tracker and won’t load the tracker screen for me to resync, even after I deleted it and reinstalled.

reviews.title: Tracker
reviews.text: The app is not counting all my steps from the Apple health app. It is off by approximately 500 steps every day

reviews.title: Trouble syncing
reviews.text: In all fairness, it could be my phone or Apple health, but I’m pretty decent when it comes to technology. I’m having a heck of a time getting count it to pair with my tracking device. Kinda defeats the purpose to have to do manual entries.

reviews.title: Difficult
reviews.text: The app is not user friendly

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I personally think Count.It challenges are an incredible, affordable way to get co-workers talking to each other, and moving more. It’s work culture magic!

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: It’s supposed to sync with Apple and Samsung. When it downloads it only gives you the option for Apple and Garmin but then once you sign into Apple, it shows you a thumbnail for Garmin even though that’s not what you’re using. It also doesn’t sync with. My friends Samsung phone, he had to manually put in his stuff then once he got it to sync my stuff didn’t work. This isn’t even beta good

reviews.title: Doesn’t count all steps
reviews.text: It doesn’t add in all y steps from my Fitbit. It only shoes half the number I took. Have done all the trouble shooting and nothing fixes it.

reviews.title: Update hover positioning
reviews.text: Please make it so that counter updates don’t hover over the button to add activities — makes it very frustrating.

reviews.title: Inconsistent double counting and bad UX
reviews.text: Why running only counts as steps at 4 pts for every 10 but tennis and pickleball get 100 points per minute PLUS steps is beyond me. Makes no sense. Also the constant individual adding of the wellness activities is frustrating. Takes so long that I end up being on my phone more than normal because the app interface is not efficient. It’s also not an intuitive interface. Plus the tracker connection isn’t always correct. And if it misreads my fitness app, there is no ability to correct. All in all. Not a great app.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: Too many clicks to get to the content I routinely need to use or to log activities. Having to type in start and end times for everything is a huge pain. Difficult if not impossible to see team standings.

reviews.title: Every Step Counts Towards a Better YOU!
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Count.It Journey app for Healthiest CIO Challenge at work and I absolutely love it. It’s fun, easy to use, and gives me the extra push  to move more each day. Whether I am walking , dancing or chasing my kid around the house the app keeps me motivated and accountable. Step by Step I’m Leveling Up My Wellness Game!  If you’re looking for a fun way to stay active and track your progress, this app is a must have! Getting Fit has never felt so rewarding! 💪🏾🎯📲

reviews.title: Entering steps manually
reviews.text: When steps are added manually, they overwrite existing steps. It does not add them to what has been captured. Which isn’t a huge deal, but it would have been nice to know that before adding manual steps. (Ex: add 500 steps manually to 3250 already captured and the system, the system now only has 500, not 3,750.

reviews.title: So easy to use
reviews.text: Enjoying the journey

reviews.title: Not really compatible with Garmin
reviews.text: The app doesn’t sync with my Garmin. It doesn’t stay synced so a lot of steps are not being tracked.

reviews.title: Difficult to add points for lifting weights, yoga, etc
reviews.text: Found a step conversion chart online. Need to add to app the following day and add to the steps it captured in your day.  Very cumbersome and manual

reviews.title: Clunky app with no way to manually track workouts
reviews.text: I would like to manually track my workouts because I do a lot of yoga and swimming and things that no pedometer can track. I have no fitbit or smartwatch or garmin, so I have to enter all these workouts on my apple Health app, which is terrible and slow in its own interface, and then I must sync it to CountIt, often manually. I only use the CountIt app to try to accumulate points for my company’s wellness program, but believe me, if there was no incentive, I would definitely not use CountIt. It wastes so much time to get data into it.

reviews.title: Doesn’t sync in anything close to real time
reviews.text:
This app really has issues. No one in my challenge has their steps accurately displayed. Sometimes it takes hours for the app to sync with our trackers—so what’s the point of a competition if you have no idea where you fall in the race?! Someone in my group said all her steps were just wiped out all together! 
I’ve reached out for help and the responses do not solve the issues we’re having.

reviews.title: Tracker connected but all points deleted
reviews.text: Tracker connected but all points deleted at end of challenge. I’m very competitive and connected Apple Health to seamlessly log activity points. After time change, all my activity was removed from Count.It app. This app does have access to all of my Apple Health data too btw

reviews.title: Consistency in App
reviews.text: I cannot understand how my tracker works in two challenges simultaneously with no issue. One closes and I start another and none of my steps, exercise, etc gets tracked even though it is connected to the same one. This is the third time I have encountered this with Count it.

reviews.title: Does not support purchases on phone
reviews.text: Takes me to website outside of the app to enter payment details. I should be able to use Apple Pay like all my other apps.

reviews.title: Got me super motivated
reviews.text: Admittedly, I’m a very competitive person. So I really liked seeing how I was beating my coworkers. And even though I didn’t come in first, I loved knowing how far away the finish line was. WAY BETTER than the  internal HR driven program at my last firm. Having a great app changes the game.

reviews.title: Love the app and competition!!!
reviews.text: I love love LOVE how simple and functional the app is— but even more, I LOVE how the competition angle spurred me on to get my butt moving as much as possible! I can be a little lazy— but good friendly competition and the whole set-up was super motivating. Fun, easy, and motivating— what more can you ask for!?

reviews.title: Perfect for people who don’t like fitness apps
reviews.text: The Count It app required zero work on my part to get it to keep track of my activity and the interface actually worked to motivate me to destroy my [friendly] competition. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Super helpful
reviews.text: Great experience! It worked so well for our challenge and was so easy to use. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Very fun
reviews.text: I hesitate to give any app five stars, but CountIt earns it. This was such a fun group challenge. Easy to use and motivating!

reviews.title: Very fun challenge!
reviews.text: So fun to see your progress and the suspense of when your friends sync their steps!

reviews.title: Simple and convenient
reviews.text: The easiest way to track a fitness challenge across platforms and devices. Simple and straightforward.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: Loved using this app to do a healthy challenge between friends. Just the right amount of playful, competitive and fun.

reviews.title: Count.it Rocks!
reviews.text: I hate to exercise and this app really makes doing so fun, easy and social. Glad I found it and a big kudos to the app design team for a slick easy to use UI.
